scope: Four bounded CPU Gaussian CFA/fit-index/scoring/RAM operations;partial JMP19.2 SEM numerical coverage,not a general SEM platform.
integration_status: Public execute/formal Rust tests and matching native SQL PASS; bounded partial contracts only

common_contract.input: Finite nonempty rectangular numeric matrix<=100000rows,256columns,1000000cells;operation-specific tighter shape limits;<=4096finite args.
common_contract.covariance: ML covariance uses divisorN. N-1normalization conversion is explicitly caller responsibility. Covariances must be symmetric and SPD at relative Cholesky pivot1e-12.
common_contract.CFA_identification: One active loading per indicator;>=3indicators/factor;latentvariance1;first indicator loading positive. Factor covariance is SPD and unit diagonal. Local observed-information SPD diagnoses identification;no general algebraic identification or global optimum certificate.
common_contract.CFA_parameter_order: standard_errors/parameter_covariance order:active loading per indicator(p),uniqueness per indicator(p),free factor correlations lower triangle row-major if correlated. Manifest means are free parameters and count toward k;mean_covariance=implied covariance/N is reported separately. CFA k=3p+q(q-1)/2 when correlated,3p otherwise.
common_contract.CFA_inference: Optimizer convergence,identified,Heywood uniqueness boundary,latent boundary separate. SE/parameter covariance,overall fit p,RMSEA interval and information criteria null unless converged identified interior. Fitted means/covariance and discrepancy/indices remain descriptive candidate values. No parameterwise Wald p/CI.
common_contract.CFA_limits: <=20manifest variables,<=4factors,max1000iterations,100000likelihood/gradient evaluations or1e9nominal p^3work units. Line search<=50trials. Log anchor/uniqueness coordinates[-25,25],active normalized loadingsabs<=100,factor-correlation free coordinatesabs<=1000. Solver gradient threshold=sqrt(tolerance)clamped[1e-7,1e-5]. Heywood uniqueness<=1e-8 in standardized units;latent anchor<=1e-8,conditional factor covariance pivot<=1e-8,or coordinateabs>999boundary.
common_contract.saved_model: score_parameters=[p,q,means(p),Lambda row-major(pq),Phi row-major(q²),uniquenesses(p)]. Prefix method0/1when calling cfa_scores.
common_contract.fit_indices: df=p(p+3)/2-k includes means. Independence baseline mean=observedmean,cov=diag(S),df0=p(p-1)/2. Baseline discrepancy within64eps*p is treated as numerical zero. Undefined zero-df or baseline denominators returnnull. AICcnull whenN<=k+1.
common_contract.RMSEA_convention: Uses displayed official equation sqrt(max(chi2-df,0)/(N*df)),without arbitrary upper clipping. Help prose saysbounded0..1while its displayed formula lacks upper clipping;the unbounded formula choice is an explicit implementation interpretation,not a verified installed-JMP behavioral claim. CFI/TLI/NFI are clipped[0,1]as prose specifies;RNI is raw/unbounded.
common_contract.RMSEA_CI: Poisson mixture of central gamma CDFs,built around Poisson mode;normalizes retained weight mass. Max noncentrality1e7,max50000mixture offsets,gamma convergence<=200000iterations,bracket/bisection75steps. CentralCDF<=target gives zero noncentrality boundary;zero modeldf givesnull. Cap/no convergence givesnull interval plus explicit status.
common_contract.RMR_SRMR: Unique lower triangle covariance residuals plus all mean residuals,denominatorp(p+3)/2. SRMR covariance residuals divided bysqrt(Sii*Sjj),mean residuals bysqrt(Sii). No omission of nonzero mean terms.
common_contract.RAM: p<=16;linear-system inverses use elimination with pivot rejection. Static invertibility and discrete dynamic stability distinct. Stability solvesP-BPB^T=I by p^2-dimensional linear system;SPD P=>strictly stable,nonSPD=>not strictly stable,singular/numeric unresolved=>null. This extra algebraic diagnostic is not an SEM identification/causality claim.
common_contract.unsupported: No general SEM fitting,cross-loadings,residual correlations,FIML,multigroup/measurement invariance,robust correction,modification indices,or GUI.

operations.data: p3..20summary rows,each p ML covariance entries followed by sample mean. N-divisor covariance is required;N-1conversion is caller responsibility.
operations.estimator: True Gaussian summary-data ML with freely estimated manifest means. Each indicator loads on its specified one factor;latent variances fixed1 and first indicator loading positive to identify scale/sign. Positive uniquenesses and SPD correlated factor matrix. Analytic Gaussian score with correlation-coordinate chain rule;BFGS local search and Richardson derivatives of analytic score provide observed information. Physical-parameter delta covariance accounts for sign/scale constraints. Heywood/latent boundary,optimizer convergence and local identification are separate. No global optimum guarantee.

operations.description: Saved CFA factor scores: observation rows; [method0regression/1Bartlett,score_parameters...].
operations.data: Finite raw observed-variable rows,n×p;order matches stored means/loadings. <=100000rows/1000000cells.
args: method0regression posterior mean/1Bartlett weighted least squares
operations.estimator: Regression scores Phi Lambda^T Sigma^-1(x-mu),with conditional latent posterior covariance. Bartlett scores solve Lambda^T Theta^-1 Lambda and return measurement-error covariance. Reuses supplied saved parameters;no refit or propagation of fitted parameter uncertainty.

operations.description: Gaussian SEM fit indices: rows[S_MLrow(p),Sigma row(p),observedmean,modelmean]; [N,kfree].
operations.data: p1..20rows,each2p+2columns:observed ML covariance,model implied covariance,observed mean,model mean. Both covariances SPD.
args: k_free exact integer0..p(p+3)/2,includes all free covariance and mean parameters
operations.estimator: Evaluates supplied Gaussian mean/covariance model. Chi-square=N*[logdetSigma-logdetS+tr(Sigma^-1S)+(mean difference)^T Sigma^-1(mean difference)-p]. Degrees of freedom=p(p+3)/2-k. Independence baseline has observed means and diagonal S. Reports central chi-square p,CFI/RNI/TLI/NFI,RMSEA with90%noncentral chi-square interval,RMR/SRMR with explicit mean residuals,Gaussian loglikelihood,AIC/AICc/BIC/BICu. Caller supplies valid model parameter count and is responsible for ML estimation/model assumptions.
unsupported: checking supplied model was estimated by ML

operations.description: Supplied RAM mean/covariance: rows[Brow(p),Omega row(p),intercept]; no parameters.
operations.data: p1..16rows,2p+1columns:B path coefficient row,SPD disturbance covariance Omega row,intercept. B diagonal must be zero.
operations.estimator: Solves simultaneous linear system with A=I-B:mean=A^-1alpha,covariance=A^-1Omega A^-T,total=A^-1-I,indirect=total-B. Static invertibility is separate from strict discrete dynamic stability;the latter uses a discrete Lyapunov solution SPD diagnostic and may be null at a singular/numerically unresolved boundary. Positive Omega/invertibility do not establish model identification,fit or causality.
